majors.name: Strategist
majors.desc: Increases hero's Command by +2, increasing number of units that can be fielded on the battlefield at a time.

subs.name: Champion
subs.desc: Makes elite units stronger

subs.name: Tactician
subs.desc: Teaches the hero to use special orders during combat to have units move or attack in an empowered way. Each can be used once per day without cost.

subs.name: Swarming
subs.desc: Creates phantom duplicates of some of the creatures in hero's army.

subs.name: Affinity
subs.desc: Gain +1 Proficiency. Immediately gives 45 power worth of your hero's specialty unit

majors.name: Aeromancy
majors.desc: Teaches a new Air spell and improves Air spells

subs.name: Wind Pace
subs.desc: Increases unit speed and gives them a chance to retreat instead of dying

subs.name: Stormbringer
subs.desc: Creates a storm during battle which moves around the battlefield. It knocks away friendly units, deals damage to enemies

subs.name: Wing Master
subs.desc: Makes flying units stronger, and increases the power of Air spells

majors.name: Fortune
majors.desc: Increases the luck of creatures in your army

subs.name: Lucky Star
subs.desc: Your hero is more lucky when picking up resources and they no longer spend movement points to pick them up. Immediately spawns some treasure around the hero

subs.name: Gambler's Wheel
subs.desc: Gain a random blessing now, as well as in 2, 4 and 6 levels

subs.name: Inspiration
subs.desc: Learn a random skill. Increase XP gain by 10%

subs.name: Luckyguards
subs.desc: Gives the hero four Monokeros and ten Wildkind as entourage

majors.name: Terramancy
majors.desc: Teaches a new Earth spell and improves Earth spells

subs.name: Stone Heart
subs.desc: Makes units protected from the first attack against them, and increases the power of Earth spells

subs.name: Life Aether
subs.desc: All your living units gain a chance to create permanent Anima or Forest Spirits when they die

subs.name: Terraforming
subs.desc: Creates a Terraformed unit at the start of battle. It grows and becomes stronger whenever you cast Earth spells

subs.name: Grave Guard
subs.desc: Units you lose during battle will return as spirits during that battle or later battles

majors.name: Smithing
majors.desc: After combat, gives the hero a chance to gain or upgrade an artifact.

subs.name: Archery
subs.desc: Gives ranged units in your army a chance to fire true-strike projectiles

subs.name: Swordsmith
subs.desc: Makes offensively-oriented units stronger

subs.name: Shieldsmith
subs.desc: Makes defensively-oriented units stronger

majors.name: Necromancy
majors.desc: After combat, allows the hero to spend mana on raising the undead.

subs.name: Mana Drain
subs.desc: When enemy units die during combat, they may restore mana to your hero

subs.name: Undying
subs.desc: Gives +5 defense to undead units. Additionally your undead units gain a 10% chance to resurrect some time after being killed

subs.name: Putrid Air
subs.desc: All living units lose 4-6 health every 5 seconds during battle

subs.name: Second Chance
subs.desc: Whenever permanent living units die, they have a chance to become permanent undead units

subs.name: Life From Death
subs.desc: After combat, some of your undead units will transform into living units

majors.name: Demonology
majors.desc: After combat, allows the hero to sacrifice some of the experience gained to summon demonic reinforcements.

subs.name: Demoncaller
subs.desc: Teaches the hero three spells that summon demons. Gain +2 spellpower

subs.name: Possession
subs.desc: When your demonic units die, their spirits are released and will conjoin. Together, they will take permanent control of an enemy unit with up to 25% the power of the lost units.

subs.name: Demonic Reduction
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a spell to transform enemy units into weak imps

majors.name: Pyromancy
majors.desc: Teaches a new Fire spell and improves Fire spells

subs.name: Inferno
subs.desc: Whenever you cast a fire spell, you also create a living fireball which moves around the battlefield randomly for 1 minute, dealing damage and setting enemies aflame

subs.name: Fire Heart
subs.desc: Gives the attacks of all units a chance to set enemy units on fire. Increases the power of Fire spells

subs.name: Fireleaper
subs.desc: Gain +1 movement after combat for each fire spell cast

subs.name: Cataclysm
subs.desc: Casting fire spells kills a few of your units, but the spell is cast a second time elsewhere on the battlefield

majors.name: Leadership
majors.desc: Increases morale of units in your army by +1

subs.name: Plunder
subs.desc: Lets your hero loot gold and artifacts after combat

subs.name: Heroism
subs.desc: The hero gains +100 health and +5 damage during combat. When they take damage, they summon low tier units of their faction

subs.name: March Onwards
subs.desc: Gain +1 movement per morale after the first battle won each day

subs.name: Persistence
subs.desc: Living units have a chance to resurrect after some time

majors.name: Carnage
majors.desc: Teaches the hero a Blood spell. Additionally, the hero will gain health and a temporary damage buff whenever any of their units die during combat

subs.name: Gold Teeth
subs.desc: Gain gold when you lose army units

subs.name: Bloodwarping
subs.desc: After combat, allows the hero to transform some of their basic creatures into elite creatures

subs.name: Antagonism
subs.desc: Teaches a special spell, which allows the hero to enter a duel against the strongest hero of any opponent

subs.name: Bloodlust
subs.desc: Gives a bloodlust buff whenever allied units die during combat

majors.name: Armorer
majors.desc: Increases health of units and protects against ranged attacks.

subs.name: Warding
subs.desc: Protects units against attacks from large enemy units and from spells

subs.name: Plating
subs.desc: Units take reduced damage from attacks

subs.name: Lifelink
subs.desc: Living units can regenerate up to 20% of their max health over time. When a living unit is about to die, it can save itself by borrowing some health from nearby allies

subs.name: Oligarchy
subs.desc: Improves quality of your units, but reduces the hero's Command by 1, decreasing number of units that can be fielded on the battlefield at a time

majors.name: Hydromancy
majors.desc: Teaches a new Water spell and improves Water spells

subs.name: Hex
subs.desc: Turns some enemy creatures into frogs at start of combat.

subs.name: Frozen Heart
subs.desc: Gives the attacks of all units a chance to freeze enemy units.

subs.name: Healing Rain
subs.desc: Whenever you cast a water spell, healing rain will fall, which restores health and removes debuffs from your units, and damages some enemies

subs.name: Drown
subs.desc: Teaches the hero an 8 mana spell that floods the battlefield, dealing damage to most units, and having a chance to turn killed units into Drowned

majors.name: Offense
majors.desc: Increases attack speed of units and lets their damage increase as they lose health

subs.name: Forceful Strike
subs.desc: Your melee units have a 20% chance to deal 3x damage with their first attack

subs.name: Legion
subs.desc: Increases the health and damage of all units by a flat amount

subs.name: Aggression
subs.desc: Increase unit attack speed and unit movement speed, and unit damage increases as they take damage

subs.name: Cult of Muscle
subs.desc: Gives the hero a Physique as entourage, and creates a Herculean each day for the hero's army

majors.name: Mysticism
majors.desc: Teaches the hero a mystical spell that cannot be learnt by other means. Additionally, increases the effectiveness of all spells by 25% per rank

subs.name: Destruction
subs.desc: Gives a chance for your units to cast a spell when they die

subs.name: Manalife
subs.desc: Whenever you spend mana, heal your units by that much mana, and have a small chance to resurrect your dead units

subs.name: Buffer
subs.desc: Gives the hero a mana buffer, making it so that the first 2 points of mana spent each fight isn't spent. Additionally, decreases the cost of Advanced and Ultimate spells.

subs.name: Blight Ritual
subs.desc: Transforms all units in the hero's army into Blighted, and makes Blighted units stronger

majors.name: Bodyguards
majors.desc: Increases hero's Entourage by +2, giving them extra bodyguard units during combat, good for support heroes.

subs.name: Diplomacy
subs.desc: After combat, allows your hero to hire some of the defeated enemy units for gold.

subs.name: Underdog
subs.desc: Your units become stronger if the enemy army is deemed Challenging or harder

subs.name: Banditry
subs.desc: Gives the hero Mercenary units each turn. Teaches Ambush, which allows the hero to go into a special combat scenario, from which they gain gold and experience

majors.name: Summoning
majors.desc: Teaches a new Summoning spell and improves Summoning spells

subs.name: Elementalism
subs.desc: Summons elementals throughout combat

subs.name: Avatar
subs.desc: Creates permanent elementals when the hero casts elemental spells they have increased power in

subs.name: Hegemony
subs.desc: After combat, allows the hero to spend sulphur to create <UPGRUNITNAME> for their army.

majors.name: Engineering
majors.desc: Improves Ballista and First Aid Station

subs.name: Planning
subs.desc: Decreases cost of buildings in all towns

subs.name: Sapper
subs.desc: Generates mines throughout the battlefield, which will trigger when enemy units step on them, casting a fire spell

subs.name: Mason
subs.desc: While the hero is camped, they will create and reinforce a fort. Additionally, increases the defenses of all your town's walls and number of ranged units manning their towers during sieges

majors.name: Faith
majors.desc: Teaches the hero a Prayer and a random spell. Increases hero's knowledge by 2

subs.name: Learning
subs.desc: Increases the rate at which your hero gains experience by 25% per rank

subs.name: Resurrection
subs.desc: Teaches a Resurrection spell, which will permanently resurrect friendly units

subs.name: Wisdom
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a spell from a choice of four spells. Additionally, gives the hero +1 knowledge and +1 spellpower.

subs.name: Potency
subs.desc: Allows the hero to cast a Potent version of any spell they know, which costs twice as much mana. Additionally, makes units with magical attacks stronger

majors.name: Estates
majors.desc: Gives your hero 250 gold each day per rank

subs.name: Productivity
subs.desc: Mines and other map buildings that generate resources or units will generate double every second day.

subs.name: Nobility
subs.desc: +1 to hero's Morale, Command and Proficiency

subs.name: Recruitment
subs.desc: Increases the weekly growth of units in all your towns. The effect applies immediately when ranked up

subs.name: Royalty
subs.desc: Decreases the cost of creating units in all towns

majors.name: Healing
majors.desc: Heals dead units after winning a battle.

subs.name: Recalcitrance
subs.desc: Gives a chance for your units to create a vengeful spirit when they die

subs.name: Vigour
subs.desc: Your living units gain +10 health. Healing units can now heal three times as many times

subs.name: Grand Physician
subs.desc: Add 10 Medicians to the hero's entourage

majors.name: Devour
majors.desc: Teaches your hero a special Devour ability, which Devours friendly units but gives temporary and permanent stat buffs

subs.desc: Teaches the Spit spell which can be used daily. When used, it damages and pushes away enemy units. If you've devoured units, it also creates ghosts of those units

subs.name: Belch
subs.desc: Whenever units are swallowed, devoured or voraciously eaten, a large poison effect that damages nearby enemies is created

subs.name: Digest
subs.desc: Teaches the Devour and Digest spell, which devours your own units to permanently increase the attack and defence of your hero

subs.name: Swallow
subs.desc: Gives the hero +100 health, and when the hero damages enemies, the enemies might be swallowed.

majors.name: Horror
majors.desc: Gives -3 morale per rank to enemy units in combat

subs.name: Toxicology
subs.desc: Makes poisonous blobs fall from the sky early in combat

subs.name: Tragedy
subs.desc: Gives -2 luck to enemy units in combat

subs.name: Betrayal
subs.desc: Enemies have -2 morale. Terrified enemies have a chance to join your side

majors.name: Mastery
majors.desc: Increases hero's Proficiency by +2, improving their specialisation with <UNITNAME>

subs.name: Survival
subs.desc: Whenever a unit is about to die, it has a 10% chance to instead gain 50 health and a morale boost

subs.name: Midas Touch
subs.desc: When the hero and their <UNITNAME> attack, they have a chance to turn enemies into golden statues, instantly killing them and adding gold to the hero's coffers.

subs.name: Conversion
subs.desc: At the end of each day, converts up to 40 power worth of units in hero's army into 55 power worth of hero's specialty unit

subs.name: Elite Guard
subs.desc: Gives the hero around 60 power worth of the hero's specialty unit as entourage

majors.name: Logistics
majors.desc: Increases the distance your hero can travel each day by 5 tiles per rank

subs.name: Scouting
subs.desc: Gives movement boost after combat and allows seeing further.

subs.name: Dizzy Tune
subs.desc: Teaches your hero a special Dizzy Tune ability that can be used once every two days. Confuses a large group of enemy creatures.

subs.name: Mercurial
subs.desc: Spends 1 mercury each day (if possible) and creates Mercurial creatures for the hero's army.

majors.name: Sorcery
majors.desc: Whenever you cast a spell, your spellpower is increased for the rest of the fight. Additionally decreases the cooldown of casting spells in combat.

subs.name: Creation
subs.desc: After combat, the hero will create some magical creatures for their army

subs.name: Regeneration
subs.desc: Increases mana regeneration

subs.name: Echo
subs.desc: Whenever a spell is cast, an echo of that spell will be cast again later during combat

subs.name: Spatial Rift
subs.desc: Teaches Spatial Rift, an overworld spell that allows the hero to swap units and swap place with your other heroes

majors.name: Combat
majors.desc: Increases damage, health, speed and all other stats of the hero on the battlefield.

subs.name: Brawn
subs.desc: Adds +4 to hero's attack and defense, but reduces hero's spellpower and knowledge by 1 each

subs.name: Skepticism
subs.desc: Gives the hero an anti magic aura, reducing nearby enemy units damage and health to their base values, clearing transformations and dealing damage to summoned units

subs.name: One on One
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a spell to remove all units but those selected from the battlefield, letting the hero fight them alone

majors.name: Dragonking
majors.desc: Gives dragonblood points after combat. When enough has been collected, it can be turned into a large dragon, or several smaller dragon units.

subs.name: Dragonform
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a spell that turns them into a dragon for 30 seconds and summons dragon whelps when transforming into and back out of the dragon form

subs.name: Guard of None
subs.desc: Gives the hero 12 Nones as entourage

subs.name: Dragonslaying
subs.desc: Your melee units deal 150% damage to enemies with 8+ power, and 200% damage to enemies with 25+ power

majors.name: Creativity
majors.desc: After combat, gives the hero a chance to learn a new skill at a small experience cost

subs.name: Prism
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a spell that targets a single enemy or friendly unit, creating a group of copies of it in all the colours of the rainbow

subs.name: Customisation
subs.desc: Removes half of the hero's stat points, then allows you to place those stat points and 2 new stat points freely as desired

subs.name: Whimsy
subs.desc: During battle, random spells get cast, and War Clowns fall from the sky

majors.name: Adventurer
majors.desc: The hero gains a bonus whenever they interact with a building or pickup on the overworld map for the first time.

majors.name: Discovery
majors.desc: The hero gains a bonus whenever they interact with a building or pickup on the overworld map for the first time.

subs.name: Herbalism
subs.desc: Find herbs around the world, which give potions, movement boosts and resources

subs.name: Split Branch
subs.desc: Choose a secondary unit for Proficiency. Gain +1 Proficiency and 30 power worth of those units.

subs.name: Liberty
subs.desc: Allows the hero to freely allocate the gained stats of this level-up as well as 4 extra stat points

subs.name: Heirloom
subs.desc: Whenever the hero levels up, an artifact will be discovered close to them.

majors.name: Hoard
majors.desc: Improves the hero's stats the more gold is hoarded

subs.name: Mana Crystals
subs.desc: Gives +1 Crystal each day. Gives hero a mana buffer during combat equal to half the number of crystals owned, but for every four mana spent of that buffer, also spends a crystal

subs.name: Buying Life
subs.desc: Resurrects 40% of lost units by spending gold after combat

subs.name: Golden Blood
subs.desc: When your permanent units die, they have a chance to turn nearby enemy units into golden statues, instantly killing them

subs.name: Dragonskin
subs.desc: Your living units gain +5 health. Additionally units with power 8+ take 2 less damage from all attacks

majors.name: Call Beasts
majors.desc: Summons beasts throughout combat

subs.name: Bestial Fury
subs.desc: Gives all living units +2 damage. Additionally, your beasts gain Insensate ability, which allows them to keep fighting for a while after death

subs.name: Life summoner
subs.desc: Learn a special summoning spell, which summons a permanent group of beasts

subs.name: Rootcaller
subs.desc: Summons roots throughout battle that entangle enemy units, making them unable to move for some time

subs.name: Questing
subs.desc: Increases the rate at which your hero gains experience by 25%. Additionally, creates a Questing Raffe at the start of each battle, which will distract enemies

majors.name: Chemistry
majors.desc: Gives the hero a potion each day and when ranked up

subs.name: Analysis
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a spell to transform high tier enemies into a flock of low tier units of the same type

subs.name: Test the Flesh
subs.desc: Creates a transfiguration zone when deploying your units before battle. Units placed in it are transformed into other, generally stronger, units

subs.name: Research
subs.desc: Increases future stat growth by 20%. Additionally, allows the hero to learn a new skill, with two options displayed after each battle until one is picked

subs.name: Midlife Crisis
subs.desc: Gain two levels, but the hero turns into an entirely different hero with a different army

majors.name: Infest
majors.desc: Whenever the hero visits a mine, vault, monument or adventure map building, they get the option of turning it into a Spore Mound

subs.name: Spore Spreading
subs.desc: Summons Spore units throughout combat when fighting nearby a Spore Mound

subs.name: Budding
subs.desc: Whenever a unit takes damage, it has half a percent chance per damage taken to bud off a smaller version of itself

subs.name: Neurotoxin
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a Neurotoxin spell, which will either confuse, paralyse, charm, fear or poison enemies

subs.name: Mychoral Guard
subs.desc: Gives the hero 12 Mychorals as entourage

majors.name: Tinker
majors.desc: Gives the hero Amberodes and Dactylodes as bodyguards

subs.name: Crystal Assembly
subs.desc: Whenever the hero picks up overworld resources, Crystalthemums are added to their army

subs.name: Exploitation
subs.desc: Allows hero to deposit units in mines. Units in mines improve the output of the mine

subs.name: Artillery
subs.desc: Gives the hero a war machine, and teaches the hero to cast Fireworks once per day

majors.name: Lovely Tune
majors.desc: Teaches your hero a special Lovely Tune ability that be used once every two days. Lovely Tune buffs and protects friendly units for some time

subs.name: Inspiring Drum
subs.desc: Teaches the hero the Inspiring Drum spell, which gives a group of units high morale. The spell also gets cast on a random group of units whenever the hero uses Lovely Tune or Dizzy Tune.

subs.name: Energetic Jam
subs.desc: Teaches the hero the Energetic Jam spell, which heals and resurrects friendly units. Casting Energetic Jam will also reduce the cooldown of Lovely Tune and Dizzy Tune by 1 day.

subs.name: Peace Binding
subs.desc: Binds some enemy units to become unable to fight, instead just wandering the battlefield in confusion

subs.name: Province Guards
subs.desc: Each day, the hero gains an entourage that lasts until next combat. It grows when unused.

majors.name: Rallying
majors.desc: Gives rallying to all friendly units close to the hero,

majors.name: Blessing
majors.desc: Blesses all friendly units after casting a spell

subs.name: Royal Tribute
subs.desc: Gain 500 gold whenever you defeat a neutral opponent

subs.name: Salary
subs.desc: Allows the hero to activate the Salary effect at the start of combat: Whenever a human unit is fielded during combat, it gains +2 morale and +5 defence, but it costs 5 gold for every 2 power

subs.name: Old Mirth
subs.desc: Gain +1 morale, and adds 15 Dragonslayers to your hero's entourage

majors.name: Wild Communion
majors.desc: Teaches Wild Call, which summons animals into battle when used

majors.name: Lifespark
majors.desc: Whenever the hero casts a spell, the hero additionally heals nearby units and summons animals onto the battlefield.

subs.name: March of Nature
subs.desc: Gain a permanent +1 morale. Additionally, gain 6 movement and +2 morale for next fight whenever the hero overgrows a mine

subs.name: Lunar Rites
subs.desc: Gives the hero an immediate reinforcement of 5 Nighthowlers. Additionally gives the hero a random blessing now as well as at the beginning of each coming week

subs.name: Elven Artillery
subs.desc: Gives the hero 15 Deadeyes as entourage. Additionally, give +5 attack and +5 defense to Rangers, Deadeyes and Lynxes

majors.name: Aethercraft
majors.desc: Allows the hero to collect Aether from defeated enemies. When entering combat, 20% of Aether is converted into elementals summoned around the hero

majors.name: Aethermancy
majors.desc: Allows the hero to collect Aether from defeated enemies. When entering combat, 20% of Aether is converted into spells which are cast automatically

subs.name: Scholar
subs.desc: Increases xp gain by 25% and teaches the hero a spell now as well as each time they level up

subs.name: Spire Attunement
subs.desc: Adds +10 spellpower when casting spells from the arcane spire, and allows using two arcane spire spells per fight

majors.name: Bane
majors.desc: The hero passes the Curse of Undeath on to enemies through their attacks, which turns enemy units into permanent undead units. When the hero dies, a group of skeletons are summoned.

majors.name: Malediction
majors.desc: Spreads the Curse of Undeath when casting spells, which turns enemy units into permanent undead units.

subs.name: Turn Living
subs.desc: Teaches the hero a spell that transforms enemy living units into undead units under your control

subs.name: Frost Lich
subs.desc: Gives the hero 3 Liches as entourage, and gives Soulmages and Liches in hero's army Freezing attacks

subs.name: Coil of the Dead
subs.desc: Gives your undead units the death coil ability

majors.name: Firegating
majors.desc: Teaches Firegating, which teleports friendly units across the battlefield when used

majors.name: Firetrapping
majors.desc: Gives the hero a special Firetrapping spell. The spell teleports enemy units across the battlefield and weakens them

subs.name: Great Feast
subs.desc: Learn an adventure map spell that throws a great feast

subs.name: Ritual of Power
subs.desc: Learn an adventure map spell which allows your hero to spend movement points to level up once every four days

subs.name: Venomus Demonicus
subs.desc: Gives the hero 35 gluttons as entourage, and your demons gain venom strikes

majors.name: Might
majors.desc: Gives the hero 0-mana spells for use in battle

majors.name: Ardour
majors.desc: Gives the hero 0-mana spells for use in battle

subs.name: Sandcaster
subs.desc: Teaches the hero an Air and Earth spell, and gives +5 spellpower when casting Air or Earth spells

subs.name: Ritual of Flesh
subs.desc: Goblins in your army learn to cast a spell which transforms some of them into Trolls, Cyclopses or Bloodletters

subs.name: Hero's Horde
subs.desc: Gives the hero 60 goblins as entourage

majors.name: Hunting
majors.desc: The hero has a chance to pick up hunting trophies whenever they defeat armies with beasts in them. Additionally allows the hero to track down hidden beasts

majors.name: Taming
majors.desc: Units in the hero's army become able to convert defeated beasts to fight for their side. Additionally allows the hero to track down hidden beasts

subs.name: Bog Witching
subs.desc: Teaches the hero three spells to summon Toadfrogs, Sneagles or Swamp Warders during combat

subs.name: Swamp Silver
subs.desc: Your beasts and lizardfolk take 3 less damage from attacks

subs.name: Scale Lord
subs.desc: Gives the hero two Rexes as entourage. When your Slithering Temple produces Great Hydras, they appear in this hero's army

majors.name: Shadowcasting
majors.desc: Teaches the hero Shadowcasting, which summons temporary shadow-clones of enemy units when used in battle

majors.name: Shadowcloning
majors.desc: Teaches the hero Shadowcloning, which summons temporary shadow-clones of the hero and nearby allies when used in battle. Additionally, the hero has a chance to create shadowclones of any enemy they strike

subs.name: Tunnel
subs.desc: Learn an adventure map spell that moves your hero up to 6 tiles within the same area as the one they're in

subs.name: Doppelganger
subs.desc: Creates a shadow doppelganger of your hero, which acts as a Lieutenant.

subs.name: Dragon Whisperer
subs.desc: Gives the hero a Gold Drake as entourage

majors.name: Siren Song
majors.desc: Teaches the hero Siren Song, which permanently takes control of enemy units close to the hero during battle. Additionally, the attacks of the hero gain a chance to charm enemy units for the rest of the fight.

majors.name: Conflux
majors.desc: Whenever the hero casts a spell, some elementals of the same element as the spell will be summoned and fight for you for a short time

subs.name: Fire Dance
subs.desc: Teaches the hero an adventure map spell that gives +2 movement, as well as +2 attack and Spirited Fires for the next battle

subs.name: Ways of the Sea
subs.desc: Teaches the hero an Air and Water spell and gives them +1 Knowledge. Gain +2 daily movement and an extra +3 movement at sea

subs.name: Pearl Crown
subs.desc: Gives the hero four Temptresses as entourage. Hero gains +1 attack and +1 defense for each pearl found so far, and each found in the future

majors.name: Soul of the Earth
majors.desc: Whenever a dwarven unit dies, they leave behind a soul. Several souls combine to summon Rock Pummelers that will continue the fight.

majors.name: Grudge
majors.desc: Whenever a dwarven unit dies, they leave behind a soul, which, when activated by a spell, becomes a vengeful spirit

subs.name: Earthen Eternity
subs.desc: Teaches the hero an adventure map spell which resurrects lost Earthen units from the last battle

subs.name: Gold Digger
subs.desc: Teaches the hero an adventure map spell which creates a Gold Vein on the overworld map.

subs.name: Carve Guards
subs.desc: Teaches the hero an adventure map spell which creates an entourage of Earthen units for the next fight, but which costs movement

majors.name: Union
majors.desc: Gives the hero +120 health per rank. Whenever a unit close to the hero is about to die, the hero will save them from death

majors.name: Balance
majors.desc: Teaches Balance spell, which selects an area of the battlefield. Any friendly units close to death will be saved within this area

subs.name: Uphold Tradition
subs.desc: Hero gains +4 defense, +1 knowledge and +1 command, but loses -2 attack and -1 spellpower. Upgraded Pillar units gain the regeneration ability, regenerating up to 50% of their max health over time

subs.name: Serene Meditation
